title: 7.1 tier-band width formula (wire × 2.2) restated in four render sites across two files
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:274:  width := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:290:  band := width * 2.2
app/render/view.odin:665:  base_w := (tier_pipe_width(v, tier) + f32(count-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:668:  width := base_w * 2.2 - 2.0 * lane_gutter(v) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:798:  width := (tier_pipe_width(v, bundles.bundle_tier[bi]) + f32(bundles.bundle_count[bi]-1)*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale
app/render/view.odin:799:  halo := width * 2.2 + 6 * v.scale // 7.1: the selection halo hugs the WIDE band
app/render/crisis.odin:143:  band := (tier_pipe_width(v, bundles.bundle_tier[b]) + f32(max(0, int(bundles.bundle_count[b])-1))*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale * 2.2
detail: Four sites restate the band formula; a future band-scale or canon tweak edited in only some sites silently desyncs lanes, riders, selection halo, and crisis outline — exactly the drift class lane_gutter was extracted to prevent.
recommended_fix: Hoist bundle_band_width(v, tier, count) -> f32 beside tier_pipe_width/lane_gutter; derive the band, rider inner width, selection halo, and crisis outline from it.

title: draw_crisis_banner keeps private copies of crisis_banner_rect's layout constants
evidence:
app/render/crisis.odin:27:  card_w := i32(440)
app/render/crisis.odin:30:  line_h := i32(17)
app/render/crisis.odin:49:  card_w := i32(440)
app/render/crisis.odin:50:  line_h := i32(17)
app/render/crisis.odin:51:  x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2
detail: The card and hit-test rect are correctly single-sourced via crisis_banner_rect, but text centering/advance still use duplicated literals (440/17); editing one proc drifts text placement inside the shared rect.
recommended_fix: Share named constants (e.g. BANNER_CARD_W, BANNER_LINE_H) between the two procs, or derive text x/advance from br inside draw_crisis_banner.

title: Doorstep fan offsets duplicated for queued-on-edge and at-node packets
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:648:  kx := f32(int(p.id % 5) - 2) * 0.13 * s
app/render/view.odin:649:  ky := f32(int((p.id / 5) % 3)) * 0.11 * s
app/render/view.odin:650:  pos = {depart.x - 0.80 * s + kx, depart.y + 0.62 * s + ky}
app/render/view.odin:692:  kx := f32(int(p.id % 5) - 2) * 0.13 * s
app/render/view.odin:693:  ky := f32(int((p.id / 5) % 3)) * 0.11 * s
app/render/view.odin:694:  pos.x += -0.80 * s + kx
app/render/view.odin:695:  pos.y += 0.62 * s + ky
detail: The identical deterministic fan (same id-keyed offsets) is copy-pasted in both branches — the comment even says 'same fan as the queued-on-edge read above'; a tweak to one copy splits the two queue reads.
recommended_fix: Extract doorstep_offset(id: u64, s: f32) -> (f32, f32) beside lane_gutter and call it from both branches.

title: Crisis banner y-placement rule lives in both the new app proc and the harness inline copy
detail: 7.1 introduced the shared banner_y proc for the app's draw + hit-test, but the harness's identical inline placement math remains a second copy that can drift from it.
recommended_fix: Move banner_y(health_on: bool) -> i32 into the render package beside crisis_banner_rect/HEALTH_CARD_H; both the app and the harness capture path call it.
